## Problem

Describe one concern in one or two sentences. Link the owning issue.

## Change

Explain the resulting behavior and the smallest change that produces it.

## Verification

List executed local checks, relevant security/performance evidence and unverified
behavior. Link authorized, redacted GitHub attachments; do not commit PR-only assets.

## Review

- One concern; choose the size label using CONTRIBUTING.md.
- Request an eligible owner's review.
- Monitor checks/review bots on the latest commit. Merge requires explicit authorization.
